# Perfetto Desktop v0.2.4

Patch release for Windows installer branding.

## Fixes

### NSIS installer uses the app icon

The Windows NSIS installer and uninstaller now explicitly use the project's
`icons/icon.ico`, so the `.exe` installer shown in Windows Explorer carries the
same branding as the desktop app.

GitHub Releases attachment icons are still controlled by GitHub, and MSI files
may still show the Windows Installer shell icon depending on Explorer behavior.

## Install

### macOS arm64

1. Download `Perfetto.Desktop_0.2.4_aarch64.dmg` from the assets below.
2. Open the DMG, drag **Perfetto Desktop.app** to **/Applications**.
3. If macOS Gatekeeper blocks first launch:
   ```sh
   xattr -d com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Perfetto Desktop.app"
   ```

### Windows x64

1. Download either `Perfetto.Desktop_0.2.4_x64-setup.exe` (NSIS) or
   `Perfetto.Desktop_0.2.4_x64_en-US.msi` (MSI).
2. Run the installer. SmartScreen may prompt because the binary is not yet
   code-signed; choose **More info -> Run anyway**.
